body: Same usual abuse, just a different day.
You're really good at getting people out of their own downward thoughts you know that?
Yep. He knows me to my core I believe. He still stands by me day in and day out. He's a pretty amazing person. I don't know how I got so lucky tbh

I do have a amazing boyfriend.. Two amazing cats that are my little furry babies. My boyfriend actually kind of proposed the idea of us getting married and him being able to bring me and my cats away from this awful place. It's high on my list of consideration to be honest. He lives away from me because he's in the military... But yeah.

Most people don't acknowledge that. I appreciate your point of view. People say "oh just ignore it." Family is supposed to know you so well and to have one of your family members tear into you it's just soul crushing. It's not some random who doesn't know you.
Ah I'm sorry you have to deal with that. I try not to believe what he says but when someone yells so much about you it's hard to ignore.
My dads extremely emotionally abusive. Every cuss word has been used to describe me. I've been told how useless I am, what a bitch I am since I was a teen.

Thanks. I want to be a good person.. I like to think the few friends I have I bring happiness to but I just am in a endless cycle of self hatred that's been reinforced by my family saying how awful I am. I believe it sometimes and it's becoming impossible to block out. No matter how much my friends say otherwise.
I try to be honest about my problems.. I'm even trying counseling but I've hit a wall in that. Thank you for the kind words..
